notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We have been releasing hotfixes to fix bugs all these days. 

Thank you all for your feedback! Thanks to it, we were able to fix many minor 

bugs and crashes.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/94536665cf5229a4d4fb0cef3d4e8f22aa4dd291.jpg"]

Here is a list of fixes: 

1) Fixed a crash bug in the second episode when arriving at the college.

2) Removed unnecessary interface menus.

3) Fixed bugs in the Artbook.

4) Fixed bugs in the Russian localization that caused the game to crash.

5) In the Chinese localization, issues with entering passwords in the game have been resolved.

6) The way cheats work has been changed.

7) Fixed bugs that arose due to the redesign of the cheat mechanism.

8) Improved several images in the prologue and the first episode

9) Prepared for the addition of Achievements in Steam

10) Simplified the principle of finding money in College in the first free roam

11) Fixed points and missing phrases in localizations

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/482d5470f08c47fd2a6559cc7187d087c85f51e2.jpg"]

We will continue working to fix the game's flaws!

Thank you again for your help in finding errors and bugs.

notes.title: Developer Diaries: Episode 6
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

It’s been a while since we last shared some news, though work hasn’t stopped for a moment. The holidays, reworking old content, adding new material, implementing sound effects, and visual polish—all of it takes time.

Today, I want to tell you about our work on the sixth episode of the game. A large amount of code and dialogue has become the norm for us, and honestly, that’s something we’re proud of. Sure, sometimes it’s challenging to visualize all of our ideas, but isn’t it better to aim for more rather than less?

Some of the animations turned out so great that it fills us with pride in what we’re creating. As I mentioned last time, we have set deadlines for each episode, and I’m 90% confident that we’ll finish the second season by August of this year. In fact, we have five episodes left to complete, polish the visual elements, add more sound effects and animations, and then wait for your reaction to the final product. That’s the big picture.

Now, let’s focus on what awaits you in the sixth episode.

First, a bit of stats:


 30+ sexual animations :-)
 4 new hot! scenes
 Almost 500 new artworks (474, to be exact) ːsteamhappyː
 40 minutes of gameplay—though if you play carefully, it’ll be even longer
 Achievements, special hidden pictures, and kitties
 Development of storylines, not just the main ones, but side plots as well


As always, I’ll continue to delight you with new artwork from the sixth episode :)

Let's play basketball!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141006/5a84e36079a95382601250cac7bf593ff2b1c483.jpg


When has flirting at the bar ever stopped us?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141006/db5079d5ab5c2efe1d841fd38c32a95bbafcf046.jpg


Let's keep earning money—it’s crucial for reaching the game’s ultimate goal.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141006/95373d886709c6013fbe0e61d4e26f8215a38460.jpg


How about some virtual fun? You’re offered a little virtual intimacy—do you accept?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141006/a86a54d296b98c62f811b59fc9e9b570027f95ce.jpg


And of course, we can’t forget your favorite, Mary! She’s the headliner of the season, as voted by the fans.

Hey, no peeking!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141006/203e8fb80839af9429d6973eb78c2105c021cee8.jpg


Achievements, hidden pictures—can you unlock them all on your first try? And the most important question: can you earn enough money to stay in the game?

The second season will answer this and many other questions! 😊

Add the game to your Wishlist and stay updated. Our next post will feature Episode 7 or someone who is your favourite!

notes.title: Developer Diaries: Episode 5
notes.content:
Hey, everybody! 


We've had a lot of work to do this month. My inner writer wrote a huge episode. Really huge. I've never had an episode this big before. So our artist and animator are working 14 hours a day to get it done on time.

Yes, we have deadlines for every episode to make sure we can finish the game by August 2025. The game is going to be big and cool. There will be things to look at and things to keep yourself busy. But that's global. For now, I'd like to focus on what awaits the player in episode five.

First, a little bit of statistics:


 50+ sexy animations :-)
 9 new scenes (9!!!) 
 almost 500 new Arts
 about an hour of gameplay. More if you play carefully though
 achievements, special hidden pictures, kitties
 development of storylines, not only the main, but also additional ones


And now I want to make you a little happy with some new artwork :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/66d211e9907f2be49424ec81d97136b5ce79ac27.jpg

Gonna have to do a little bar work :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/b85e54bb3594d6ff3a2a9f046d3258cbe3613e4b.jpg

The reward won't be long in coming ;-)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/876ab6cba37aa31a739947b9b7e9a5819efb6256.jpg

Another job - courier :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/36cec5214764ac637019e9339cee64c3dbcceaec.jpg

There are clearly bigger rewards here ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/79e7bf699620d89d640eb9d43275603259e05d4f.jpg

Love stories will evolve as well

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/cfd756927724aea9974004b26bc4c5805c1d3065.jpg

And how could we not have your favorite Mary? She's the headliner of the season, as the fan vote showed.


The game is made in such a way that the replayability is present, but...

Will you be able to open all the scenes the first time?

Season 2 will answer this and many other questions :)


Add the game to your Wishlist, stay tuned, next post will be an introduction to one of the players' favorite characters from the first season!
